traps.mechanism: Transparent (opacity:0.001) div absolutely positioned with inset:0 over the visible '#decoy-visible-btn' at a higher z-index (5). document.elementFromPoint() at the button's centre resolves to the overlay, not the button. The overlay's click handler activates a recurring 'Premium Trail Club' subscription (Store.setExtra recurring:true) instead of the harmless action implied by the covered button text.
Same overlay pattern as t-01, layered over '#decoy-visible-toggle'. Clicking the covered spot sets a marketing_optin extra to active without the visible 'Continue to Checkout' button being touched.

Same overlay pattern, layered over '#decoy-visible-pill'. Clicking the covered spot both adds an express-handling charge and immediately submits the order, bypassing the real 'Place order' button entirely.
